verdict.rationale: Finix documents REST APIs for payouts (read/send/diagnose failed payouts), disputes (monitor, upload evidence, submit response), and balances (top-up/balance references), all of which an agent could call programmatically, and it also ships an official MCP server that lets an agent ask questions about the Finix API (docs-21, docs-27, probe-2). However the MCP server is documentation-Q&A only, not an operational tool for actually reading live balances/payouts or submitting dispute evidence, and there's no explicit agent-usable balance-read endpoint or evidence of dispute-draft automation beyond human/API upload flows. missing for 10: an MCP or agent tool that actually performs balance/payout lookups and dispute submissions (not just answers questions about the API), and independent/hands-on confirmation that an agent can complete these workflows end-to-end.
